name: XTR hydraulic dual-control lever pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed complete left/right ST-M966 dual-control shift and hydraulic brake-lever pair, triple front and nine-speed rear. The brake-lever table explicitly labels the figure as a pair weight; this is not a complete caliper, hose and rotor system weight. Cable/housing inclusion is not specified.
